actual_case_checks_required: Compare saved runtime_controls.source_admission.chunk_ids and admitted_evidence_ids with the exact Service Reminder numeric IDs. Gap presence alone is insufficient.
If admitted numeric IDs are absent, distinguish final ranked-hit selection from diagnostic retained-gap membership.
If IDs are present, inspect saved composition.failure_code, sanitized draft_validation_failure, verdict_summary and failed_provider_trace for the actual refusing stage.
Preserve missing-context authority and exact citation bindings; only a demonstrated concrete cause can justify a generic minimum repair.
diagnostic_plan_status: Owner selected existing live API single-case path; prepared native observer remains unused and unsubmitted bootstrap draft is ignored history.

findings.finding: Each non-complete-context sibling creates a non-rider-resolvable gap and is skipped; it does not discard independently complete reviewed anchors in the selected chunk.
Only selected_anchor=True adds approved dependency closure and anchor IDs. A chunk retained only as gap diagnostics does not contribute its otherwise reviewed numeric objects.
coverage_established is bool(payload.evidence); source_review_required is independently bool(payload.gaps). Approved numeric objects and three gaps can coexist.
Actual retrieval assembles at most five ranked search hits. BM25-only rank7 is not proof of exclusion because dense/RRF and conditional reranking also determine selection.
No approved evidence skips reranking as SOURCE_REVIEW_REQUIRED; otherwise parent-rank disagreement may rerank and continue with source gaps.
Composer checks scope/runtime/model/cache identity and source payload validation; no unconditional gap rejection is present.
Admitted gaps are passed into the model source context; the policy forbids citing gap IDs or asking the rider to repair missing review.
Native citation enum contains only admitted evidence keys. Missing context IDs cannot acquire authority merely by being in gaps or the same section.
Release still requires exact source citations, finalized-response verifier support/coverage and no omissions/conflicts; source gaps alone do not imply acceptance.
